plugins.name: media
plugins.title: Media
plugins.description: Edit a video or a photo with the agent: mark where something is wrong on the frame, and the agent trims, cuts, sets exposure, speed and volume, crops and turns it, then renders the result.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user wants to edit a video or a photo, to show you a moment or a spot in one, or to choose between takes, clips or photos by playing or looking at them

plugins.name: google-docs
plugins.title: Google Docs
plugins.description: Edit a Google Doc with the agent: it proposes changes, comments and replies, you approve them or type in the doc yourself, and Send puts them in Docs as suggestions.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user wants to write, edit or review a Google Doc, or answer its comments

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.title: Delegate
plugins.description: Hand easy, self-contained tasks to a conversation on another profile, such as one running a local model; its answer comes back to the agent when it finishes.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user wants tasks handed to another profile or a local model, or to save their main model's usage on easy ones

plugins.name: checklist
plugins.title: Checklist
plugins.description: A checklist of the steps of the agent's work beside the canvas, which the agent and the user tick as they go.

plugins.name: review
plugins.title: Code review
plugins.description: Code reviews and guided tours of the code flow, with findings on the diff that the user keeps or drops and posts to the pull request.
plugins.recommendWhen: the user wants code reviewed or explained
